name: Fadd (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow light grey horizontal stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fadd (a red and blue shield with a fish, a plough and a wavy stripe, within a green wreath) above a scroll inscribed FADD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Fadd arms with wreath and scroll
